attention_limit.description: Sources listed per attention bucket (default 5; the *_count fields always carry the full tally). Pass up to 500 for the exhaustive roster, 0 for counts only.

consumer_id.description: smry-managed progress: poll this consumer's saved predicate. Omit cursor and where.

cursor.description: Caller-managed progress: "latest" to start, then the next_cursor you stored.

fields.description: Project event entries to these fields; ["id"] is the cheapest diff. id is always included.

where.description: Entry selection predicate: fields AND together; omit a field to not filter on it. Source queries/mutations accept only collection and source; use query having for source-health filters.

classification.description: The Collection filter's binary delivery decision and optional underlying assessment. Requires exactly one Collection.

items.description: A collection id or its exact name.

discovered_after.description: When smry first saw the entry. Backfill makes old posts look new here, so use it for diffs, not for "what's new". Relative window ("7d", "36h", "45m", "2w"), "now", or ISO date.

match.description: Case-insensitive text match over title and summary. "a OR b" matches either.

published_after.description: When the source published the entry (entries with no publish date are excluded; use top-level since to include them). Relative window ("7d", "36h", "45m", "2w"), "now", or ISO date.

items.description: A source id (from any v2 response) or its title. Reads also accept a fragment that matches exactly one title.
A source id (from any v2 response) or its title. Reads also accept a fragment that matches exactly one title.

unread.description: true = only unread entries, false = only read entries.

name: get_feed_changes

attention.description: Source health, capped to five per bucket (stalled: longest silent first; erroring and never_produced: alphabetical); the *_count fields carry the full tally. Query select:"sources" with having for the complete list.

ack_required.description: True only for managed delivery; acknowledge next_cursor after processing every event, including an empty batch.

entry.description: The entry, projected to the requested `fields`. `id` is always present. entry.classified events also carry the filter's decision, assessment, reason, and filter_revision.

type.description: entry.discovered: smry saw this entry for the first time. entry.classified: a Collection filter reached a decision about an entry you already have.
